about.title: About
about.description: I work on the parts of the product nobody sees until they break.
paragraphs: Most of my career has been spent close to money and close to scale — KYC onboarding for US banks, a multi-provider payment service moving millions a month, and now high-traffic content APIs at Warner Bros. Discovery.
I care about the unglamorous things: clean service boundaries, idempotent writes, queries that stay fast at the 99th percentile, and dashboards that tell you what broke before a customer does.
My default toolkit is TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis and AWS, with Kafka or RabbitMQ when services need to stop talking synchronously. I reach for the boring, provable option first.

experience.description: Backend and GraphQL services for Bleacher Report, serving high-traffic sports content to millions of fans.
achievements: Build and maintain Node.js and GraphQL services powering Bleacher Report's content delivery, tuning resolver-level data fetching and caching to cut redundant upstream calls.
Own observability for owned services with Datadog metrics, dashboards and SLO-backed alerts, improving production visibility and shortening time-to-detection on incidents.
Partner with platform and frontend teams on schema design so client teams can ship without breaking API contracts.

experience.description: Payment infrastructure and compliance-heavy onboarding platforms for US fintech clients.
achievements: Architected a KYC onboarding platform adopted by 3 US banks, cutting onboarding time by 40% while meeting PCI-DSS requirements.
Designed a multi-provider payment service processing $2M+ in monthly volume at 99.99% uptime, using Strategy and Factory patterns so a new provider takes 3 days to integrate instead of 2 weeks.
Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing across services, turning opaque cross-service latency into traceable spans and measurably faster incident triage.
Mentored engineers through design reviews and set the team's conventions for service structure, error handling and API versioning.

experience.description: ERP modules digitising workflows for state government authorities.
achievements: Delivered ERP modules used by 13+ government authorities, replacing paper workflows with auditable digital ones.
Rewrote reporting queries and indexes, taking a core report from 5 minutes to 45 seconds.

projects.name: Multi-Provider Payment Service
projects.shortDescription: One API over four payment gateways, with provider selection resolved at runtime instead of at deploy time.
projects.longDescription: A modular payment service that normalises four providers behind a single contract. Strategy and Factory patterns handle provider selection and instantiation, so routing rules change without touching call sites. Handles 5,000+ daily transactions with idempotent writes, queued retries via RabbitMQ and Redis-backed rate limiting.

projects.name: Real-time Podcast Platform
projects.shortDescription: Live audio for 10,000+ concurrent listeners over WebRTC, with chat and analytics that keep up.
projects.longDescription: A live audio platform combining WebRTC for low-latency broadcast, Icecast for scale-out listening, and Socket.io with Ably for chat and presence. RabbitMQ absorbs analytics events so the streaming path never waits on the reporting path.

projects.name: AI-Powered HR Assistant
projects.shortDescription: Retrieval-augmented assistant answering 1,000+ HR queries a day against real company data.
projects.longDescription: An internal assistant built on LangChain and GPT-4 that answers policy, leave and notice queries with 92% resolution accuracy. FAISS embeddings cover 10,000+ documents and dropped semantic search latency from 2s to 300ms; SQL agents handle safe DML against PostgreSQL for the write paths.
